title: Box Office Group Sales Manager - Butler Arts
description:
Position Overview

The Box Office Group Sales Manager is responsible for sponsorship,
group, and student rush sales and supports the overall ticket sales
and daily operations of Butler Arts. This role focuses on
generating additional revenue through sponsorship sales, box suite
sales, and premium seat sales while providing exceptional service
to patrons, sponsors, and community partners. The position also
supports box office operations, student staff, and event
management.

The Box Office Group Sales Manager works closely with the Box
Office Senior Manager to ensure accurate ticketing operations and a
high customer service standard .

Responsibilities

Serve as a primary contact for sponsorship- related ticket
sales, coordinating and facilitating sponsorship sales
Lead box suite sales for Clowes performances, including
communicating with prospective patrons, managing reservations,
processing payment, and maximizing potential seating revenue
Coordinate and process group ticket sales by responding to
group sales inquiries and developing customer relationships
Process ticket orders and support for partner
organizations
Perform daily box office functions, including order fulfillment
and inquiries while ensuring accuracy in transactions
Assist with ticket inventory management, student rush tickets,
and other ticketing needs in Archtics, ensuring events are
correctly configured and ready for sale
May occasionally operate University-owned vehicles or operate a
vehicle on the University’s behalf, to transport individuals,
equipment, materials, and supplies in support of departmental and
University activities.
Other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

2-4 Years experience in a box office
Bachelor’s degree
Proficiency with Word, Excel, and Teams
Experience with Archtics and Ticketmaster is required
Must possess and maintain an acceptable driving record in
accordance with University policy.

Preferred Qualifications

Sponsorship or group sales experience preferred

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
